evidence: We have systematically investigated the ALD growth characteristics and the material properties of Zn(O,S) films deposited from dimethylzinc (DMZn, Strem), ultrapure H2O, and H2S.12 In addition to deposition using equal number of precursor cycles according to the pulsing sequence DMZn/N2/H2O/N2/DMZn/N2/H2S/N2 (denoted as a ZnO/(ZnO þ ZnS) cycle ratio of 0.5), films have been grown by ZnO/(ZnO þ ZnS) cycle ratios of 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The 0.2 and 0.4 ratios refer to deposition by using supercycles consisting of one ZnO cycle followed by four ZnS cycles and of two ZnO cycles followed by three ZnS cycles, respectively. In analogy, the 0.8 and 0.6 ratios refer to supercycles of a ZnS cycle followed by four ZnO cycles and of two ZnS cycles followed by three ZnO cycles, respectively. Needle valves controlled the rate of dosing of each precursor and N2 was used as the purge gas and as the carrier gas at a constant flow rate of 60 sccm.
